title: coelogyne galbana
intro: Coelogyne galbana, commonly known as the Galban Orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne galbana include wound healing and anti-oxidative stress, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
